_comment: MHGU Switch save (system, 5159100 bytes). Offsets are absolute, little-endian, from a single-character save of the EU/western release 0100770008DD8000. See README.md open questions before assuming portability across character slots or regions.
_confidence: CONFIRMED = two independent lines of evidence; DERIVED = single observation; UNRESOLVED = located but not decoded

header_nonce.note: changes every write; NOT a checksum; leave untouched

container.note: both commit slots must be written identically; emulator must be closed

levels_seen_bit.note: cleared bitmap + 0x100 bytes; this is the quest seen bitmap (clears NEW), not an unlock flag

deviants.level_order: bit j = level j in progression order; final bit of each block = EX
deviants.gating_note: G-rank deviant levels additionally require one cleared G-rank quest against the base monster (Bloodbath: event flag 1226). Not a flag of its own: the unlock script reads the ordinary cleared bitmap; quest lists in docs/03-deviants.md 'Unlock gating'. DERIVED, write not tested

monsters.indexing_note: offset = base + stride*index; index 0 is NOT a slot (base points one element before the array). MHXXSwitchSaveEditor uses 0-based arrays starting one element later: editor index = index - 1

hunt_tallies.note: kills only; captures are stored separately

capture_counts.note: editor SIZEOF_MONSTERCAPTURES = 274; Monster List shows N(M) with N = tally + capture, M = capture (4 monsters checked); capture diff (Nargacuga) touched capture[32] only, tally unchanged

size_records.note: large monsters only; (0,0) = never hunted; 0x192D62-0x192D65 are captures[136..137], NOT a size record

index_blocks.106-112: unused (dummy1-dummy7 in the game's monsterName table)
index_blocks.113-135: additional large monsters incl. GU-exclusive deviants; 134 = empty slot (code 0x57, empty name)
index_blocks.names: romfs GUI/06_msg/monsterName_eng.gmd entry i-1 = index i (DERIVED, agrees with every confirmed row)

monsters.deviant_rollup_note: CONFIRMED: deviant hunts do not increment the base monster tally; family total = base + deviant

weapon_usage.alignment_warning: bases are ODD addresses; arrays are not 2-byte aligned
weapon_usage.all_tab: computed at display time, not stored
weapon_usage.semantics: quests completed with that weapon, not hunts
weapon_usage.order_warning: storage order differs from on-screen bar order

bitmaps.seen: rel 0x2D77 (+0x100), CONFIRMED by controlled diff: highlighting a NEW quest sets it; does NOT control board visibility
bitmaps.third: rel 0x2E77 (+0x200), DERIVED: quest failed (end state 5). Set by 0x526b98 from the quest result code; read by the Hunter's Notes unlock 0x55515c as 'met the monster'
bitmaps.note: index = position of the quest ID in game resource quest\quest_group (rQuestGroup, loc/arc/village/common.arc); index 0 is a placeholder; 0x18F900-0x18F912 is NOT part of the bitmap; deviant level bitmaps are indices 947-1174

request_flags.note: event flag bitmap; villager request i uses accept_flag / done_flag from data/request-index.csv (activityData.atd record +0x33 / +0x35). Setting accept_flag posts the request quest on the village board (controlled write: bit 396 -> quest 607). Followed by npc_hold_bits and 2 x u32 (UNRESOLVED, change on every save)

npc_hold_bits.layout: 3 x 24-byte bitmaps A/B/C, LSB-first, bit = NPC index (u16 id table at 0x162793c of the v1.4 executable = order of NpcName_<lang>.gmd)
npc_hold_bits.note: Controlled write: map B bit 36 (0x1B92E5 bit 4) kept the Kokoto Chief from offering request 22 while the other chiefs offered theirs; all three maps were empty after the next cleared quest. set bit = NPC skips talk blocks of kind 8 (request offer) / 9 / 3 (announcement); set by talk action 2/3/26 (a request report sets A), wiped by the quest flow step 0x38b904. Snapshot pair: reporting 10220 to the Argosy Captain set A bit 33. See docs/10-npc-talk.md

request_offers.note: offer conditions of 182/184 requests ('a|b' = either; the selector stops at the first empty condition slot); zero violations against the 116 accepted rows of the save (190 condition groups: flag, cleared, key sets, star level, HR, points, progress bits). NPC bit index in data/npc-index.csv. Star-level flags of the unlock rules are set by kind-3 talk blocks of the chief and the quest counter NPC

unlock_rules.note: board visibility = game script script\check_quest_unlocked (rCommonScript, loc/arc/village/common.arc), run per quest ID; reads event flags (rel 0x2C56D), cleared bitmap, HR (rel 0x28) and hub_star. Zero violations against 990 seen quests; controlled writes: flag 396 -> quest 607, flag 1059 -> five Village 10-star Advanced quests. cleared bit of 11404 -> 11446 (all + atleast rule), cleared bit of 619 plus rotation bit 8 -> 618. hub_star not write-tested

village.note: talk context byte 4 (0x243bd4); village_star conditions of all accepted requests hold

star_levels.writer: 0x50cbd0: level L is set when all urgents of quest_group group 23+L (Village) / 33+L (Hub) are cleared and the stored level is lower; never lowers. Runs after a quest clear (0x388e54) and from talk condition 64; NOT on load. CONFIRMED by controlled write: Hub 13 -> 12 (0x1B9178) with all urgents cleared survived a load and a save, and was 13 again after the next cleared quest (1038)

talk_state.note: save state the NPC talk data reads or writes, docs/10-npc-talk.md. S+0x20..+0x41f of the game's save object is copied to rel 0x280B in one piece (0x51d0a0)

contribution_points_low.note: adder 0x523a80 caps each at 20000; talk conditions 67-70 test low + G, at most 20000

progress_word.bit_20: HR limit released (talk action 1 type 5; condition 65)
progress_word.bit_31: quest 10646 was listed (latch of talk condition 64)
progress_word.other: bits 8-10 = new trading locations opened (conditions 95-97), bits 11/12 = the trader's second/third cart (93/94), from dialogue; bit 29 is read by condition 85, which no talk file uses

quest_sets.note: bit N = every quest of set N is cleared; written by 0x3f1950 only when the game sees the last clear (sets counted by 0x3b85d8), so an edit that completes a set must set the bit too. Read by talk conditions 89/90/121/161/162/163 (bits 45/46/48/98/78/99) and by the award check 0x3ec020. Bit 48 (slot1_abs 0x18FE29 bit 0) = ordinary Village 1-6 star quests, gates the four chiefs' last requests: CONFIRMED by write. Companion map (S+0xc90) at rel 0x3197

awards_game_side.note: the game's own award map, same bit order as the Guild Card copy at rel 0xC8115; notice copy (S+0xc50) at rel 0x316B. DERIVED

quest_set_notices.note: +0xc90 of the save object: set notices still to show, same bit order as quest_sets. 0x3f1950 sets a bit together with a newly set quest_sets bit, the quest result flow (0x38fab0 onwards) shows the notice and clears it. Sets without a notice (e.g. 13) keep their bit. An edit can leave it alone

palico_learned_maps.note: not quest state. +0xd78 96-bit map (test 0x5245f8, filled by 0x25ec74 from the 84 owned Palicoes, 12 slots each, level requirement) and +0xd84 57-bit map (test 0x52462c, filled by 0x262560 / 0x2625cc, some entries need a cleared quest). DERIVED from code. +0xd78 = Palico skills (96 = the entries of ot_skl_eng.gmd; callers pass a Palico's skill byte), +0xd84 = support moves (callers pass the 16 support move slots)

activity_state.note: pending reward counters of the activity manager (max 99 each); bytes 7-10 and 13-16 = village tickets. Manager tail starts at rel 0x2380F with 10 tier bytes. DERIVED from serializer block sizes, cross-checked by the Palico names (first record at rel 0x23BB6, 324 bytes each)

hunter_notes_large.note: S+0x35b0 / S+0x35c0 (talk action 6, 0x247ae4). Earlier revisions gave rel 0x5027 / 0x5037 (object order taken for file order)

random_word.note: talk conditions 106-108 compare it modulo 10000 with a threshold

rotating_quests.note: bit = index into the 51-entry table at 0x162cde4 of the v1.4 executable; a listed quest needs its bit and its unlock rule; re-rolled after each completed quest. Controlled write: bit 8 (0x191CE8 0xBE -> 0xBF) listed quest 618, which stayed hidden with its rule satisfied and the bit clear

quests.id_to_bit_mapping: data/quest-index.csv (columns group / alt / expansion = quest_group bytes +4 / +5 / +6; expansion 1 = quest added by XX / GU, DERIVED)
quests.id_scheme: decimal E P T SS NN: E=1 event, P=1 prowler, T 0 village/1 hub/2 arena/3 training/4 special permit, SS star (11-14 = G1-G4) or deviant 1-18, NN sequence or permit level (11-15 = G1-G5, 16 = EX)

date.type: u8 day, u8 month, u16 year

highlight_codes.type: u8 x 3, 36 = empty; see docs/05 quest history log

highlight_values.type: u32 x 3 first values, then u32 x 3 second values at +0x38

weapon_types.type: u8 x 4, one per party slot, weapon usage order; 15 = Palico, 0xff = empty. DERIVED from values

history_log.note: newest first; ends where the award field begins (0x254DB1). Earlier revisions used 0x2546D7 with the ID at +0, which put the record boundary 6 bytes late

quest_counter_a.note: +1 per completed quest; unchanged over a Harvest Tour (quest 201)

guild_card_play_time.note: seconds; copy of base+0x20, refreshed when a quest ends. Earlier revisions read its middle bytes as a u16 quest counter at 0x25476E

slot_pointers.note: base = 0x24 + ptr; slot 1 base 0x18CC9C in analysed save; stride 0x11F8C4

characters.note: every absolute offset above falls inside slot 1; per-character relocation likely but untested

equipment._offsets: relative to character base; slot1_abs given for the analysed save

type_level.layout: type bits 0-4, level-1 bits 5-9, bits 10-14 level-1 of the transmog source piece (DERIVED, set with +0x04 by uUICoordinate 0x148f00), bit 15 UNRESOLVED

equipped_cache.note: copy of the box entry; the constant u32 4 bytes before each copy is a runtime vtable pointer (records start at rel 0x10C). Part of the slot header: discarded on load, rebuilt on save

current_pigment.note: this copy is in the 632-byte slot header, discarded on load and rebuilt on save; the loaded copy is the player record: pigment rel 0x23B53, flags rel 0x23B7B (docs/11-save-map.md)

fields.name: 0x06 char[24], NUL-padded
fields.style: 0x88 u8 hunting style 0 Guild, 1 Striker, 2 Aerial, 3 Adept, 4 Alchemy, 5 Valor (DERIVED)
fields.art_flags: 0x8C u8, bits 0-2 one flag per art slot (UNRESOLVED meaning)

progression._offsets: relative to character base; LSB-first bitfields; set with OR

canteen_ingredients.note: setting ingredients does not add dishes. Bit i = ingredient i of table/kitchenListMenu.kcm (meat 0-8, grain 9-18, vegetables 19-28, fish 29-38, drinks 39-44), names in data/canteen.csv. DERIVED

canteen_dishes.note: includes the 2 starter meals (bits 0, 1). Bit j = record j of table/kitchenListMenu.kcm, names in data/canteen.csv. DERIVED

canteen_dishes_copy.note: subset of dishes, probably seen/new marker; safe to leave untouched

earned.note: exact match of all six in-game award grids (74 bits set) + controlled write of bit 0 (Wycademy slot 1 appeared) + full write of bits 0-99,102-131 (every slot on all six grids lit);'?' slots are computed, not stored; see docs/09-awards.md

grids.100-101: Bherna slot 26: 101 = A Pat on the Back, 100 = Veteran Hunter's Prize on a transferred card (card +0x8B8 bit 7). The card copy is OR-ed with the game-side map (rel 0x3157) by 0x161b98, so clear both to remove an award. DERIVED

earned.names: bit i = entry i of table/GC_Medal_eng.gmd; data/awards.csv

save_map._comment: from the game's own loader run under emulation (docs/11-save-map.md, data/save-map.csv); rel = relative to the character base

slots.note: all three slots read by the same chain 0x3e77b0; layout identical except element lengths inside the Guild Card lists

block_a.note: shared: sUserInfo 14 B, Palico pool 50 x 324 B at 0x4E, blacklist 100 x 96 B at 0x3F96, Guild Card copies 19852 B at 0x6516, 3 B at 0xB2A2

event_quests.record: u32 quest ID, u32 size, MT ARC (zlib)

challenge_records.record: u32 quest ID, u32 size, raw data

item_box.layout: LSB-first bit stream; item ID 12 bits, count 7 bits; ID 0 = empty

item_loadouts.layout: name char[42], 32 x (u16 item, u16 count)

my_sets_record_start.note: the loader reads 40 x 136 B from here, 6 bytes after equipment.my_sets.rel; field offsets there minus 6 = offsets within the record

palico_equipment_sets.layout: name char[42], 3 x u16 box index

guild_card.element: u32 zlib length, zlib card (6328 B), u32 state (3 card / 1 empty), 36 B trailer (u16, UTF-16 name[11], 8 B ID, u32); then padding sum(0x18B8 - length - 36)

own_card_fields.name: +0x000 UTF-16[11]
own_card_fields.equipment: +0x054 7 x 44 B (type u8 +0, ID u16 +2, level-1 u8 +4, decorations 3 x u16 +8, transmog u16 +0x28)
own_card_fields.palicoes: +0x188 3 x 580 B (main, buddy 1, buddy 2; name UTF-16 +0)
